original_test_intent: Qualify five hundred full-width Gen2-to-Gen6 transitions on the exact GB-NV-PVP PCIe path, only after proving that every component, firmware layer, and tool supports the Gen6 target.
original_method: Establish end-to-end Gen6 capability and pin Speed Change 26; for each cycle verify full-width Gen2, request Gen6, capture equalization/LTSSM and settled width with error/health deltas, then inhibit subsequent cycles at the first unsupported, incomplete, or failed result and recover out of band.
manual_activity: Platform/PCIe owner certifies Gen6 and approves Speed Change 26; lab personnel isolate the SUT and own console/physical recovery.
required_inputs: Positive Gen6/full-width capability evidence for every path element and firmware
Per-cycle Gen2 entry plus Gen6 request/equalization/LTSSM/settle/width/error rules
500-count, abort, final-state, artifact-integrity, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: No execution or register forcing without positive Gen6 support
Dedicated SUT with stable power/cooling and out-of-band console
Stop on unsupported mode, wrong Gen2 start, failed/late or reduced-width Gen6, new AER, endpoint/GPU/host loss, reset, thermal/power anomaly, or evidence gap
agent_execution_scope: Validate capability, topology, tool, start method, and acceptance
Run only the approved Speed Change 26 operation
Fail closed before the next cycle
Do not infer support, force speed bits, accept downgrade, clear evidence, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Certify Gen6 path and Speed Change 26 semantics
Review all 500 results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Adds both a Gen6 feasibility gate and per-cycle Gen2-start proof without weakening the source target or count.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Gen2 starting state is distinct coverage, while Gen6 support is an end-to-end channel property. A tool that exposes a Gen6 option may still downtrain or fail on an unsupported retimer, board segment, endpoint, or firmware. Each count therefore requires verified Gen2 entry followed by Gen6 equalization, full-width settle, and error deltas. Missing capability means BLOCKED execution, and missing start evidence invalidates that cycle rather than authorizing a retry.
